guides.favoredWhen: Fine lane for her, but you outscale and stat-check once defensive. Bait mobility, hold R.

keyTips.text: She dodges Q with mobility: vary the angle.
She avoids empowered E: Q-hit means E now.
Your W hard-counters her dashes: hold it for E.

tips.text: She baits R with a backward step: R when she steps in.
Fine lane for her: concede early, scale.
You outscale and stat-check her once she builds defensive: force it.
She saves mobility for E: hold E until she commits.
Dashes baited plus R landed: the Akali who never Es first never wins.

guides.favoredWhen: She Ws herself so he can't R on, and her R answers his. Dodge Qs, turn away on R.

keyTips.text: Your W grounds his R: hold it for his dive.
He dodges every Q: lead the snakes.
He Rs your ult: cast it where he lands.

early-lane.text: Zed often places Living Shadow before Death Mark so he can swap away from skillshots. Hold your crowd control until he has used the swap.

win-condition.text: Death Mark always lands Zed behind his target. Pre-aim crowd control and escapes behind you, not toward where he cast it.

tips.text: His shadow poke: heal through, never stand in doubles.
He turns away from your ult: R when he faces you.
Death Mark always lands Zed behind his target. Pre-aim crowd control and escapes behind you, not toward where he cast it.
Your W stops his swaps: after his R, face him down.
Chunked plus spell-less: the Zed who never respects W never wins.

keyTips.text: Take extended trades after landing Q, then chain E casts while the target stays poisoned.
Spend R to start or stop an all-in and to set up ganks, closing enough for the cone to connect.
Scale into a late damage carry by staying alive, finding safe angles, and grouping instead of splitting.

tips.text: Watch mana closely, since short cooldowns invite overspending through repeated casts.
At level 2, force an early all-in window when the lane partner can follow it up.
At level 3, press the clearer spike with all basic abilities online.
Turn the first finished item into stronger trades, using landed Q plus repeated E for a big health lead.
Take a side lane for experience and gold whenever no teamfight brews.
Flank before teamfights to open a stronger R angle.
Favor tight terrain where R catches several opponents, or lock down one key target with it.
Stack Tear of the Goddess by mid game to ease mana through sustained casting.
At level 9, convert maxed E into heavier follow-up once Q lands.
At level 11, press the second R rank for more damage and a shorter cooldown into mid-game kills.
Group with the team late instead of splitting and stranding allies in a 4v5.
Initiate with R when it stuns several enemies and hands the team a clear edge.
At level 13, pair maxed Q with E for stronger skirmish damage.
At level 16, use the last R rank for more damage and another control spike.

itemization.text: Stack Tear of the Goddess into mid game, since stored mana sustains long casting stretches.
